text:
ellie: Heads-up: staging build failed after the docs include refactor. MkDocs reports duplicate fragment IDs.

docs-bot: ERROR - Duplicate ID found: 'configure-auth' in 'site/guides/auth/index.html' and 'site/shared/snippets/auth.html'

sam: This looks like the shared snippet still has an H2 heading; when included in multiple pages it's duplicated in the final site.

mike: We saw this before — either strip headings from includes or give them explicit ids so they don't collide.

ellie: Quick patch: removed the leading heading from the snippet and updated the parent pages to render the H2. Opened PR #5012 with the change; local mkdocs build now passes.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.deploy/1776543210-5012  no duplicate-id warnings

jo: Can we add a CI lint to catch headings in _includes/? A simple grep in the docs workflow would do.

sam: I'll add scripts/check_no_include_headings.sh that fails if any file in docs/_includes/ starts with `#{1,6} ` — quick and effective.

mike: Also found two links in the auth guide that pointed to anchors with spaces encoded as `%20`. Replaced with normalized anchors (e.g., `#configure-auth`).

ellie: Nice. Let's also add a SHORT note in STYLEGUIDE.md: "Includes should not contain top-level headings; prefer parent pages to define structure."

docs-bot: PR updated by sam — commit 7f9c2a1.

ellie: Merging after CI green. Thanks all.
